correctness.rationale: The actual A,B,D polynomial coefficients were inspected. The 12-element A4 and 12-element C12 subgroup actions give invariant quotient functions A/D and B/D, with trivial group intersection, so the curve parametrisation is birational of degree 12 and has the two specified outer Galois points. Independently enumerated all 122 points of P1(F121) via exact F11[u]/(u^2-2) arithmetic, grouped the images into precisely 25 size-2, 6 size-3 and 2 size-4 fibers, and checked every branch tangent nonzero with pairwise nonzero determinant, including source infinity. Their delta sum 25*1+6*3+2*6=55 equals arithmetic genus (12-1)(12-2)/2, saturating the full normalization genus defect; hence no additional singularity outside F121. Exactly five nodes fixed by F11 Frobenius; source F11 points give eight distinct infinity images plus one rational affine node, #C(F11)=9. Finite enumeration proves global completeness only together with genus-saturation and birationality, not alone.
